subject.title: [Bug]: sandbox-browser noVNC clipboard garbles non-Latin-1 characters (CJK, Cyrillic, etc.)

question: Should OpenClaw replace the sandbox-browser x11vnc/Xvfb stack with a TigerVNC/Xtigervnc-based stack, provided the repair preserves noVNC password/token handling and loopback-only raw VNC exposure?
rationale: The bug and likely dependency path are clear, but the prior candidate fix demonstrated that this repair crosses the browser observer security boundary and needs maintainer approval of the VNC-server replacement shape before automation should change it.

options.title: Authorize guarded TigerVNC repair
options.body: Replace x11vnc/Xvfb with Xtigervnc only with VncAuth, PasswordFile, localhost binding, contract-label updates, focused tests, and live noVNC UTF-8 paste proof.

options.title: Choose a narrower alternate input path
options.body: Keep the current VNC stack and solve non-Latin human input through a different browser action or bridge path, leaving noVNC clipboard behavior documented as limited.

options.title: Defer the infrastructure swap
options.body: Keep this issue open without a fix until a maintainer can sponsor broader sandbox-browser VNC/display-server validation.

recommendation.title: Authorize guarded TigerVNC repair
recommendation.body: Replace x11vnc/Xvfb with Xtigervnc only with VncAuth, PasswordFile, localhost binding, contract-label updates, focused tests, and live noVNC UTF-8 paste proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the sandbox browser surface and carried the noVNC observer-auth hardening that any repair must preserve.
